component.name: Apache Subversion
component.description: Centralized version control system. The project's security page documents how to report vulnerabilities (via the ASF security reporting process) and an archive of 46 published security advisories from 2000 through 2024 covering components such as svnserve, mod_dav_svn, and mod_authz_svn; it does not document a threat model, trust boundaries, or scope rules.

externalReferences.comment: Source security page; this file is a structured translation of it. The page contains only vulnerability reporting instructions and a historical advisory archive.
